name: Dokidoki Sister Paradise 2
original_name: ドキドキしすたぁパラダイス2
source:
Main character lives alone as his father goes to establish some business abroad. One day father suddenly returns as the richest main the world! He marries a Japanese woman who is 2nd richest person in the world. She has eight adopted children, and if protagonist marries one of them he lays a foundation for world domination. He attends the same school as the new brides in question.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
